lines.en: label bathhouse20part2:
scene clearnightsky
It’s dark by the time we go outside.
lines.zh: 我们出去时，天已经黑了。

lines.en: I didn’t realize how much time had passed...but I guess it always gets dark a little earlier in the winter.
lines.zh: 我没意识到已经过了这么久……不过冬天总是黑得早一点。

lines.en: Kumon-mi, despite being incredibly different from everywhere else in more ways than you can count, is no exception to that.
lines.zh: Kumon-mi 尽管在数不清的方面都与别处截然不同，在这点上也不例外。

lines.en: I silently follow Io as she rounds the corner and heads for whatever bench she normally spends her breaks on, noticing with each hundred feet or so that her disappointment is slowly fading.
lines.zh: 我沉默地跟着 Io 转过街角，走向她平时休息时坐的那张长椅；每走过百来英尺，我就注意到她的失落正在慢慢消退。

lines.en: Like she’s hitting a different stage of life each time she passes under a streetlight, each one bringing with it a brand new, but instinctively reserved outlook on life as we know it.
lines.zh: 像是每走过一盏路灯，她就踏入人生的另一个阶段，每一段都带来一种全新的、却又本能地有所保留的人生观。

lines.en: The word “caterpillar” comes to mind.
lines.zh: “毛毛虫”这个词浮现在我脑海里。

lines.en: But it’s not the first time I’ve thought of her as something like that.
lines.zh: 但这不是我第一次把她想成那种东西。

lines.en: Something absolutely worthless, but with so much room to grow and so much left to give, if she ever elects to give anything to anyone.
lines.zh: 某种毫无价值的东西，却有着巨大的成长空间和那么多可以给予的东西——如果她真愿意给谁一点的话。

lines.en: Anyone other than me, I mean.
lines.zh: 我是说，除了我以外的人。

lines.en: I’ve already managed to win her over simply by being in the right place at the right time.
lines.zh: 我只是出现在对的地点、对的时间，就已经赢得了她的心。

lines.en: But who’s to say that our encounter was the last place or the last time.
lines.zh: 可谁又能说我们的相遇就是最后一个地点、最后一次机会。

lines.en: For all I know, someone else could swoop in and take her away the second they seem more valuable or even make {i}her{/i} seem more valuable.
lines.zh: 说不定哪天别人一出现，显得更有价值，或者让{i}她{/i}显得更有价值，就能把她从我身边抢走。

lines.en: The two of us have a lot in common.
lines.zh: 我们俩有很多共同点。

lines.en: We’ve accepted our worthlessness and rely on others to make up for what we can’t cultivate within ourselves.
lines.zh: 我们都接受了自己的一文不值，并依赖别人来弥补我们无法在自身培养出来的东西。

lines.en: Our blood is poisoned and our minds are tainted.
lines.zh: 我们的血液有毒，我们的心智被污染。

lines.en: And while Io has an entire pharmacy’s worth of pills at her bedside to counteract this-
lines.zh: 虽然 Io 床头有一整间药房的药来对抗这些-

lines.en: I have these thoughts.
lines.zh: 而我有这些念头。

lines.en: But that’s all I need.
lines.zh: 但我只需要这些。

lines.en: Because everything is going to work out.
lines.zh: 因为一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: Because life will repeat itself and mistakes will correct themselves.
lines.zh: 因为生活会重演，错误会自我修正。

lines.en: Either that or I disappear.
lines.zh: 要么就是我消失。

lines.en: I can’t lose.
lines.zh: 我怎么都不亏。

lines.en: I’d definitely prefer not disappearing, though.
lines.zh: 不过我当然还是更希望别消失。

lines.en: And for Io’s sake, temporary or not, I’m going to continue hoping that doesn’t happen.
lines.zh: 而为了 Io，无论这份存在是暂时的还是长久的，我都会继续希望那不会发生。

lines.en: : Here.
lines.zh: : 这里。

lines.en: scene iobench1
Io props herself onto the edge of a park bench, dragging her knees to her chest and shivering as a gust of wind comes to greet us.
lines.zh: Io 撑着身子坐到公园长椅的边沿，把膝盖收到胸前；一阵风迎面吹来，她打了个哆嗦。

lines.en: I sit next to her and place my {s}unnamed{/s} wooden robot down on the opposite end.
lines.zh: 我在她旁边坐下，把我的{s}无名{/s}木制机器人放在另一头。

lines.en: A minute or two goes by without any dialogue...but this is fine.
lines.zh: 一两分钟过去，谁都没说话……不过这样也挺好。

lines.en: I expected this.
lines.zh: 我早就料到了。

lines.en: Any minute now, she’ll revert back to her instinctive self-deprecation.
lines.zh: 随时她都会回到那种本能的自贬里去。

lines.en: : I really suck, don’t I?
lines.zh: : 我真的很差劲，对吧？

lines.en: See?
lines.zh: 瞧吧。

lines.en: : Why? Because you had a sensible reaction to someone insulting something you worked really hard on?
lines.zh: : 为什么？就因为别人侮辱了你花大力气做出来的东西，而你做出了合情合理的反应？

lines.en: scene iobench2
: Because I dragged you down with me.
lines.zh: : 因为我把你也拖下水了。

lines.en: : Those girls are going to remember this.
lines.zh: : 那些女孩会记住这件事的。

lines.en: : You're probably going to have to explain yourself to them now.
lines.zh: : 现在你大概还得向她们解释。

lines.en: : All I did was create more problems for you.
lines.zh: : 我做的只是给你制造了更多麻烦。

lines.en: : Which means I suck.
lines.zh: : 也就是说我很差劲。

lines.en: : I don’t see it as much of a problem.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得这算什么大问题。

lines.en: : Noriko will probably get jealous and Kirin will probably just accuse me of sleeping with you or something.
lines.zh: : Noriko 大概会吃醋，Kirin 大概只会指控我跟你上床什么的。

lines.en: scene iobench3
: Yeah...
: Not going to lie, that sounds like a pretty big problem.
lines.zh: : 说实话，那听起来是个挺大的问题。

lines.en: : I think it would be more of a problem for you than it would be for me. No one really thinks highly of me to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那对你来说比对我是个更大的问题。反正本来也没人多看得起我。

lines.en: : I think highly of you.
lines.zh: : 我看得起你。

lines.en: : It’s not a problem for me since I don’t talk to any of them. They can think whatever they want.
lines.zh: : 对我来说不是问题，因为我根本不跟她们说话。她们爱怎么想就怎么想。

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess it’s kind of hard to be ostracized when you’re already a wallflower.
lines.zh: : 也是，本来就没人注意你，也就很难被排挤了。

lines.en: scene iobench4
: I suck at being a wallflower too. I couldn’t even win the wallflower contest thing for the dorm war.
lines.zh: : 我连当壁花都很差劲。宿舍大战的壁花比赛我都没赢。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure not winning makes you a {i}better{/i} wallflower.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，没赢反而让你成了个{i}更合格{/i}的壁花。

lines.en: : Hmm...maybe.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许吧。

lines.en: : Yumi seems to be actively hated, though. While everyone probably looks at me and thinks, “Oh, right. She’s in this class.”
lines.zh: : 不过 Yumi 像是真的被人讨厌。而大家看我的时候大概会想，“哦对，她也在这个班。”

lines.en: : So I guess I’m in my own category when you look at things that way.
lines.zh: : 这么看来，我大概自成一派。

lines.en: : You’re definitely one of a kind. I’ll give you that.
lines.zh: : 你确实独一份。这点我承认。

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : You know, I'm sorry for saying this again out of what seems like nowhere...
lines.zh: : 抱歉我又像是从哪儿冒出来一样提起这个……

lines.en: : But I really think you should break up with that gyaru girl.
lines.zh: : 不过我真的觉得你该和那个辣妹分手。

lines.en: : The one that you’re well aware I’m not actually dating?
lines.zh: : 那个你明明知道我并没有在交往的人？

lines.en: : I’m not well aware of that. I still think it’s technically possible that you’re lying.
lines.zh: : 我可没“明明知道”。我仍然觉得你在撒谎这件事在技术上是有可能的。

lines.en: : Well, I’m not really sure what else I can do to prove to you that I’m not.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我真不知道还能怎么向你证明我没有。

lines.en: : You coooooould...start dating me instead?
lines.zh: : 你倒是可-以……改成和我交往？

lines.en: : I think that might help prove it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那样有助于证明。

lines.en: : Two minutes ago, you were talking about how just following you would create problems for me...and now you’re suggesting we start dating.
lines.zh: : 两分钟前你还在说，光是跟着你都会给我惹麻烦……现在你又提议我们交往。

lines.en: : Because I know you won't want to.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道你不会想。

lines.en: : And you would?
lines.zh: : 那你想吗？

lines.en: : I’ve gotta say, you don’t really seem like the type to start any sort of “official” relationship with anyone.
lines.zh: : 我得说，你看起来真不像那种会和谁开始什么“正式”关系的人。

lines.en: scene iobench5
: It’s not really something I’ve ever wanted...that’s true.
lines.zh: : 我确实从来没想要过那种东西……这点没错。

lines.en: : But I think it would be kind of nice if it were you.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得，如果是你的话，可能会挺不错。

lines.en: : It’d be really hard, though.
lines.zh: : 不过会很难。

lines.en: : Why’s that?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because I’d cry a lot.
lines.zh: : 因为我会哭很多。

lines.en: : And probably freak out on you over a bunch of different things that aren’t your fault or that you can’t control.
lines.zh: : 而且大概还会为了一堆不是你的错、你也控制不了的事冲你发疯。

lines.en: : Oh, and I have lots of medications that you would probably have to help me pay for.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有我有一大堆药，你大概得帮我付钱。

lines.en: : And I’d be up all hours of the night banging on stuff when I’m making shelves and dressers and other furniture for Uta.
lines.zh: : 而且我给 Uta 做架子、衣柜和其他家具的时候，会整夜整夜地敲敲打打。

lines.en: : So we’re moving in together, too?
lines.zh: : 所以我们还同居了？

lines.en: : I move quickly.
lines.zh: : 我进展很快。

lines.en: : Well, that’s not entirely true.
lines.zh: : 嗯，也不完全是这样。

lines.en: : In some areas I move quickly. In other areas, I’d rather not move at all.
lines.zh: : 有些方面我进展很快。有些方面我干脆不想动。

lines.en: : Yeah, this relationship is already exhausting me and it doesn’t even exist.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这段关系都把我累坏了，而它还压根不存在。

lines.en: scene iobench6
: Can I hold your hand?
lines.zh: : 我能牵你的手吗？

lines.en: : Sure. But the second you start calling yourself my girlfriend, I am walking away.
lines.zh: : 可以。不过你一旦开始自称是我女朋友，我立马就走。

lines.en: : I can not make that same mistake twice.
lines.zh: : 同样的错误我不会犯第二次。

lines.en: : That was all rhetorical. I know I’m not your girlfriend. And I know I’ll probably never {i}be{/i} your girlfriend because there are a million better choices and-
lines.zh: : 那些都只是说说而已。我知道我不是你女朋友。我也知道我大概永远都{i}做不成{/i}你女朋友，因为有上百万个更好的选择-

lines.en: scene iobench7
: Just give me your hand already.
lines.zh: : 快把手给我。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Sure. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。好。抱歉。

lines.en: : Don’t apologize. Just accept that this is a momentary sign of affection and that it does not mean we are formally dating.
lines.zh: : 别道歉。接受这只是个暂时的示好，不代表我们在正式交往就行。

lines.en: : I accept your affection and henceforth agree to not enter into a relationship with you.
lines.zh: : 我接受你的示好，并在此同意不与你交往。

lines.en: scene iobench8
: But if you change your mind...you can have me.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你改变主意……你可以拥有我。

lines.en: : What kind of “have” are we talking about here? Because that word carries some rather heavy connotations in my dictionary.
lines.zh: : 我们说的“拥有”是哪种拥有？因为在词典里那个词的含义可是相当重。

lines.en: : It means that you get to inherit Io Ichimonji and her six billion pounds of baggage.
lines.zh: : 意思是你将继承 Io Ichimonji 和她那六十亿磅的行李。

lines.en: : And that you need to figure out what to do about it because she’s been trying for years and has solved absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: : 而且你得想想要拿它怎么办，因为她试了好几年，一个问题都没解决。

lines.en: : This isn’t even high maintenance in the lowest way possible anymore. It’s just high maintenance.
lines.zh: : 这已经不是“最低限度的高维护”了。就是实打实的高维护。

lines.en: : True. But how many other girlfriends could you get right now that could build you a fence?
lines.zh: : 没错。可你现在还能找到几个会给你搭栅栏的女朋友？

lines.en: : I’m sure that line would kill in a dating profile.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定这句话放在交友档案里一定很杀。

lines.en: : Online dating is stupid. Whatever happened to traditional relationships that formed from just...people meeting each other out in public and stuff?
lines.zh: : 网恋太蠢了。那种传统的、就是……人们在外面偶然认识然后发展出来的关系，都去哪儿了？

lines.en: : Half of them ended in divorce.
lines.zh: : 其中一半都以离婚收场。

lines.en: : Oh. Right. That’s a thing.
lines.zh: : 哦。对。确实有这回事。

lines.en: scene iobench9
: Do you think I’m crazy, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我疯了吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I think neurotic is probably a better word.
lines.zh: : 我觉得“神经质”大概是更合适的词。

lines.en: : I think that’s fair.
lines.zh: : 我觉得挺公道。

lines.en: : I know better than anyone how much of a handful I can be.
lines.zh: : 我比谁都清楚自己有多难搞。

lines.en: : Thankfully, your hands are really big. And surprisingly soft.
lines.zh: : 幸好你的手很大。而且意外地柔软。

lines.en: : Have you been using our new scented lotion?
lines.zh: : 你一直在用我们那款新的香氛护手霜吗？

lines.en: : I’m surprised you can feel anything with the amount of calluses on your hands.
lines.zh: : 你手上有那么多老茧，我惊讶你还能感觉到东西。

lines.en: scene iobench10
: Hey! You already know I’m kind of self-conscious about that!
lines.zh: : 喂！你知道我对此挺在意的！

lines.en: : Does this mean I should let go?
lines.zh: : 那我是不是该松手了？

lines.en: : No! I’ve never held hands with a boy before. I like it.
lines.zh: : 不要！我从来没和男孩子牵过手。我喜欢。

lines.en: : Have you held hands with a girl?
lines.zh: : 那你和女孩子牵过手吗？

lines.en: scene iobench11
: I mean...not that I can remember. But I’m sure I’ve held hands with Uta at least once.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……我不记得有。不过我肯定至少和 Uta 牵过一次手。

lines.en: : Are you two actually closer than you look?
lines.zh: : 你们俩其实比看起来更亲近？

lines.en: : Are you about to make this weird?
lines.zh: : 你这是要把话题搞怪吗？

lines.en: : Making things weird is basically the only way I know how to function in extended conversations.
lines.zh: : 把事情搞怪基本是我在长对话里唯一会的运作方式。

lines.en: : Why else would I bring up sex so much?
lines.zh: : 不然我为什么老提性？

lines.en: : Because you're trying to groom everybody.
lines.zh: : 因为你正试图对所有人心怀不轨。

lines.en: scene iobench12
: Ow! Hey! Why are you squeezing me?!
lines.zh: : 痛！喂！你干嘛捏我？！

lines.en: : Sorry. Just a reflex.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是条件反射。

lines.en: scene iobench13
: Geez...
lines.zh: : 天哪……

lines.en: : To think a hand this soft could crush mine with almost zero effort...
lines.zh: : 这么柔软的一只手，几乎不费吹灰之力就能把我的手捏碎……

lines.en: : I bet you wish you had one of your four boxcutters on you now, huh?
lines.zh: : 我猜你现在一定希望身上带着你那四把美工刀里的一把，对吧？

lines.en: scene iobench14
: As if I’d ever go out of my way to hurt you.
lines.zh: : 我怎么会特意去伤害你。

lines.en: : If I was truly attempting to crush your appendages, I really hope you {i}would{/i} hurt me.
lines.zh: : 要是我真在试图捏碎你的手脚，我真心希望你{i}会{/i}弄疼我。

lines.en: : If you ever try to crush any part of me, I'll probably deserve it.
lines.zh: : 你要是哪天真想捏碎我的哪个部位，我大概是活该。

lines.en: : I don’t think there’s much a person can do to deserve something like that.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得一个人能做出什么值得被那样对待的事。

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我觉得能。

lines.en: : What a quick response.
lines.zh: : 回答得真快。

lines.en: : Quick and easy.
lines.zh: : 又快又简单。

lines.en: : Like sex.
lines.zh: : 就像性爱。

lines.en: : You’re making things weird again.
lines.zh: : 你又把话题搞怪了。

lines.en: : The conversation’s been going on for a while.
lines.zh: : 这对话已经聊了一会儿了。

lines.en: : Do you want it to stop? Are you already tired of me?
lines.zh: : 你想让它停下来吗？你已经烦我了吗？

lines.en: : Not really. But I can’t imagine you’re allowed to stay on break for this long.
lines.zh: : 不怎么想。不过我很难想象你能被允许休息这么久。

lines.en: : Did you actually think this was my break and that I wasn't just running away because I was about to have a panic attack?
lines.zh: : 你真以为这是我在休息，而不是我快惊恐发作了在逃跑？

lines.en: : I mean...it could have been both.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……两者都有可能。

lines.en: : I guess it could have.
lines.zh: : 我想确实都有可能。

lines.en: : I’m feeling a lot better now, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我现在好多了。

lines.en: : And I’m sure it goes without saying, but I’m glad you followed me out. Even if it seemed like I might have been trying to push you away.
lines.zh: : 我相信这不用说，不过我很高兴你跟了出来。哪怕看起来我像是在把你推开。

lines.en: : That’s gonna happen a lot from now on, you know? Times where I say the opposite of how I feel because I’m scared or nervous.
lines.zh: : 从今往后这种事会经常发生，你知道吗？有时候我会因为害怕或紧张，说出和心里想的相反的话。

lines.en: : Are you okay with that?
lines.zh: : 你能接受吗？

lines.en: : It doesn’t sound like I have much of a choice.
lines.zh: : 听起来我没什么选择。

lines.en: : You do, though. You can abandon me whenever you want and I can’t do anything about it.
lines.zh: : 你有选择的。你随时可以丢下我，而我也无能为力。

lines.en: : I’m definitely at the point where that would really mess me up, though. So...sorry to put all of that pressure on you again.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实已经到了那样会把我彻底搞垮的地步。所以……抱歉又把这种压力全压在你身上。

lines.en: : I’m getting used to it.
lines.zh: : 我已经习惯了。

lines.en: : Would you like a reward for all of your hard work?
lines.zh: : 你想要点奖励吗，犒劳你的辛苦？

lines.en: : I already got a robot.
lines.zh: : 我已经得到一个机器人了。

lines.en: : Would you like {i}another{/i} robot?
lines.zh: : 你想要{i}另一个{/i}机器人吗？

lines.en: : How about an Io?
lines.zh: : 那来一个 Io 怎么样？

lines.en: scene iobench15
: You already have an Io.
lines.zh: : 你已经有 Io 了。

lines.en: : An Io I wouldn’t mind being closer with.
lines.zh: : 一个我不介意再亲近一点的 Io。

lines.en: : But you already said you don’t want to date me.
lines.zh: : 可你明明说了不想和我交往。

lines.en: : And that’s not what I’m saying now...
lines.zh: : 我现在说的不是那个……

lines.en: : Then...you...
scene iobench16
: I think I know what you’re saying, but...
lines.zh: : 我想我明白你在说什么，不过……

lines.en: : I’m just messing around.
lines.zh: : 我只是闹着玩的。

lines.en: : Yeah. Yeah, I know.
lines.zh: : 嗯。嗯，我知道。

lines.en: : Sorry, it’s just...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，只是……

lines.en: : I know it’s not much, but...you can at least hold my hand like this whenever you want...
lines.zh: : 我知道这不算什么，不过……你至少可以随时像这样牵我的手……

lines.en: : Like, even if it’s in class or something. I’m okay with it.
lines.zh: : 就算是在课堂上之类的也行。我可以接受。

lines.en: : But...anything more right now is...
lines.zh: : 不过……现在再多一点就……

lines.en: : Why are you giving me a whole explanation? Just tell me to shut up if I say something you don’t like.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛跟我解释这么一大通？我要是说了你不爱听的，直接让我闭嘴就行了。

lines.en: : You just...sounded really serious when you...insinuated that.
lines.zh: : 你刚才……暗示那件事的时候，听起来真的很认真。

lines.en: : And I don’t want you to get your hopes up and then get fed up with me if I take too long to do what you want and-
lines.zh: : 我不想让你抱太大希望，然后因为我迟迟做不到你想要的事就对我厌烦-

lines.en: : Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: scene iobench17
: Okay.
: You wouldn’t want me anyway. I’m too scrawny and my hands are all hard. And I have stupid hair.
lines.zh: : 反正你也不会想要我。我太瘦了，手又全是硬的。而且我的头发很蠢。

lines.en: : Your hair isn’t stupid.
lines.zh: : 你的头发不蠢。

lines.en: : You directly told me my hair was stupid once and I still haven’t lived it down.
lines.zh: : 你有一次直接说我的头发很蠢，我到现在还没释怀。

lines.en: : Stop taking all of my jokes so seriously.
lines.zh: : 别把我的玩笑都当真。

lines.en: : Stop saying everything with the exact same inflection then. It’s hard to keep up.
lines.zh: : 那你别什么话都用一模一样的语气说。很难跟上。

lines.en: : Welcome to my life. Everything about you is hard to keep up with.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到我的人生。你的一切都很难跟上。

lines.en: : Everyone and everything else, too.
lines.zh: : 其他所有人和所有事也一样。

lines.en: : The world moves too quickly.
lines.zh: : 世界走得太快了。

lines.en: : And in other areas, it doesn’t move at all.
lines.zh: : 而在另一些方面，它一动也不动。

lines.en: scene iobench18
: I like you, by the way.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，我喜欢你。

lines.en: : I’m sure I’ve made that pretty obvious. But I feel like now is a really good time to come out and just say it.
lines.zh: : 我相信我已经表现得很明显了。不过我觉得现在是个直接说出口的好时机。

lines.en: : I had a feeling.
lines.zh: : 我早有感觉。

lines.en: : Like, a lot.
lines.zh: : 而且很强烈。

lines.en: : My heart is beating like crazy right now.
lines.zh: : 我的心跳现在快得要命。

lines.en: : It’s keeping me warm even though it’s like negative a million degrees outside.
lines.zh: : 哪怕外面冷得像零下一百万度，它也让我暖和。

lines.en: : Why are you telling me this when you know I’m not going to date you?
lines.zh: : 你明知道我不会和你交往，为什么还要跟我说这些？

lines.en: : Because now you’ll have no choice but to think about it.
lines.zh: : 因为这样你就不得不想这件事了。

lines.en: : If I didn’t tell you, you’d probably walk home whispering some weird monologue to yourself about how {i}I’m{/i} lost or {i}you’re{/i} lost-
lines.zh: : 要是我不说，你回家的路上大概会一边走一边给自己念叨些奇怪的独白，说什么{i}我{/i}迷失了或者{i}你{/i}迷失了-

lines.en: : But now you’ll just think about my stupid hair and my garbage robot and how dating me would be harder than adopting six babies all at once.
lines.zh: : 可现在你只会想着我那头蠢头发、我那垃圾机器人，还有跟我交往比一次性领养六个婴儿还难。

lines.en: : You really need to work on selling yourself a little better.
lines.zh: : 你真得好好练练怎么推销自己。

lines.en: : Sorry. I only sell products I’d be fine with using myself.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只推销自己也愿意用的产品。

lines.en: : Have I mentioned our new scented lotion?
lines.zh: : 我提过我们那款新的香氛护手霜吗？

lines.en: scene iobench19
: Ah! You’re squeezing again!
lines.zh: : 啊！你又捏我！

lines.en: : You’ve said “scented lotion” way too many times today.
lines.zh: : 你今天说“香氛护手霜”的次数太多了。

lines.en: : At least...take a free sample!
lines.zh: : 至少……收下这份免费试用装！
: Io……

lines.en: : Sensei! Stop!
lines.zh: : Sensei！住手！

lines.en: scene black
The two of us head back to the bathhouse and I drop Io off without going inside.
lines.zh: 我们俩往澡堂走回去，我把 Io 送到门口，自己没进去。

lines.en: There’s a distinct lack of inner monologue on my way home after that.
lines.zh: 在那之后回家的路上，我明显没什么内心独白。

lines.en: But there are plenty of thoughts about a girl with stupid hair.
lines.zh: 不过关于那个头发很蠢的女孩的念头倒是不少。
